title: Planet Tweaks V3.3.8 TITAN - Re-Engineered Zero Delay Architecture, 15 Aphrodite Tweaks, Peterbot Pointer Engine, Rapid Mouse Debounce & Safety Hardening
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.3.8 TITAN: (1) Re-engineered Pure Zero Delay (98 tweaks) and Peterbot 0-Delay Secret Pack (102 tweaks) with dual zero-delay architecture (Peterbot with pointer changer vs Pure Zero Delay strictly input/kernel). (2) 15 Core Aphrodite Competitive Tweaks added including NDU RAM leak fix, 32MB locked IO buffer, 64KB TCP buffer, and 1ms XInput controller polling. (3) High-CPS mouse click response suite added: Rapid Esports Double-Click Interval (200ms), Expanded Double-Click Hitbox, and Touchpad Palm Rejection lockout removal. (4) Keyboard packet queue depth optimized to safe 25 buffer. (5) Permanent hardware blacklist enforcement against multiplex driver failures.
